scenes.title: BETWEEN
scenes.narration: BETWEEN tests whether a value falls inside a range, endpoints included.

scenes.title: Range filtering
bullets: Checks a value against a low and high bound
Works with numbers, dates, and text
scenes.narration: BETWEEN checks whether a value sits within a low and high boundary. Both endpoints are included, so a value equal to either limit still qualifies. It works naturally with numbers, dates, and even alphabetical text ranges.

scenes.title: Filtering a date range
scenes.narration: This query keeps orders whose date lands in the first quarter of the year. Because BETWEEN is inclusive, orders on January first and March thirty-first both count. The result is every order placed within that three-month window.

scenes.title: How the range is tested
steps: Value at least the low bound
Value at most the high bound
scenes.narration: BETWEEN quietly rewrites your range into two comparisons joined by AND. The value must be greater than or equal to the low bound and less than or equal to the high bound. When both hold, the row is kept.

scenes.text: BETWEEN is a readable shorthand for inclusive range checks on numbers, dates, and text.
scenes.narration: Use BETWEEN for clear, inclusive range filters, but always remember that both boundary values are part of the range.
